results.content: Intern gebruik Horizon Europe Programme Standard Application Form (HE RIA, IA) Project proposal – Technical description (Part B) Version 5.0 04 April 2025 This annotated version of the RIA/IA template Part B is intended to support the writing of a project proposal in pillar II (Global Challenges) of Horizon Europe. Dissemination level: Use one of the following codes: PU – Public, fully open, e.g. web (Deliverables flagged as public will be automatically published in CORDIS project’s page) SEN – Sensitive, limited under the conditions of the Grant Agreement Classified R-UE/EU-R – EU RESTRICTED under the Commission Decision No2015/444 Classified C-UE/EU-C – EU CONFIDENTIAL under the Commission Decision No2015/444 Classified S-UE/EU-S – EU SECRET under the Commission Decision No2015/444 Delivery date Measured in months from the project start date (month 1) 2 You must include a data management plan (DMP) and a ‘plan for dissemination and exploitation including communication activities as distinct deliverables within the first 6 months of the project.
